entities.name: Clemens Graf von Schönborn-Wiesentheid
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Clemens Graf von Schönborn-Wiesentheid was a German Air Force officer who commanded Air Command Arad and Sturzkampfgeschwader 77 during the Axis-led invasion of Yugoslavia during World War II. He was killed in a flying accident at Sofia, Bulgaria on 30 August 1944. He was planning to attend a General Staff meeting when his aircraft crashed for unknown reasons.

entities.name: Clemens Graf von Schönborn-Wiesentheid
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Clemens Graf von Schönborn-Wiesentheid was a German Air Force officer who commanded Air Command Arad and Sturzkampfgeschwader 77 during the Axis-led invasion of Yugoslavia during World War II. He was killed in a flying accident at Sofia, Bulgaria on 30 August 1944. He was planning to attend a General Staff meeting when his aircraft crashed for unknown reasons.
